items.question: What is Vendo?
items.memoryQuery: an agent that lives inside your product
keyPoints: Vendo is an agent embedded inside the host product
It calls the host's own API as the signed-in user
Users get views they own and pre-approved automations
Everything renders inside the host's brand and guardrails

items.question: How is Vendo put together architecturally?
keyPoints: Nine packages behind one umbrella, each with one job
The host owns two files that wire Vendo in
Requests flow from the browser through the guard to the host API

items.question: How do I set up Vendo in my app?
keyPoints: Install @vendoai/vendo and run npx vendo init
Init scaffolds the server side and mounts the overlay in the layout
Start the dev server and send a first agent turn

items.question: What does vendo init actually do?
keyPoints: Scans the app with deterministic analysis, no interview
Scaffolds the server surface and the .vendo contract
Theme is extracted automatically

items.question: Where are all the doctor error codes documented?
items.memoryQuery: vendo doctor --json` is the install gate
keyPoints: npx vendo doctor --json is the install gate
Every check carries a stable id
Failing checks carry an error_code plus a fix_ref URL

items.question: How does Vendo decide which tool calls run immediately and which need approval?
items.memoryQuery: is the only sanctioned execution path
keyPoints: guard.bind(tools) is the only sanctioned execution path
Risk grades are read, write, and destructive
Risk plus policy decides what runs immediately and what asks first

items.question: What are compound tools?
items.memoryQuery: bundles a short sequence of your existing host and connector
keyPoints: A compound tool bundles a sequence of existing tools into one capability
Each step still runs through guard.bind
Approvals, grants, breakers, and audit apply per step

items.question: How do connected accounts like Gmail or Slack work?
keyPoints: Each signed-in user connects their own account once
Later tool calls run as that user
Vendo never holds a token; Composio brokers the credentials

items.question: How do I expose my Vendo tools to Claude or Cursor?
items.memoryQuery: installable in mcp clients such as claude
keyPoints: The MCP door makes the product an MCP server outside agents connect to
Clients connect over OAuth
Every door tool call runs through the same guard

items.question: How do I publish my MCP door to the official registry?
keyPoints: Publish the deployed door to registry.modelcontextprotocol.io
The registry is in preview and its data may reset
If a listing disappears, authenticate and publish again

items.question: What format are the apps Vendo generates?
keyPoints: Everything Vendo builds is an AppDocument with format vendo/app@1
Every user owns their own copy
Import, fork, sharing, and publishing mint a fresh copy

items.question: What is the in-client venue?
items.memoryQuery: render inside a sandboxed iframe by default
keyPoints: Generated apps render in a sandboxed iframe by default
Approving a specific app version lets it render in the host page
In-client apps share the page's authority and network

items.question: Can the agent compose apps from my own branded components?
items.memoryQuery: register your branded components in a catalog
keyPoints: Hosts register branded components in a catalog
The agent composes generated apps from them alongside prewired primitives
Host components render natively, not in the sandboxed iframe

items.question: How do I make Vendo surfaces match my brand?
items.memoryQuery: covers how to set the theme and see it flow through
keyPoints: Theme lives in .vendo/theme.json or a runtime VendoProvider.theme override
Every Vendo surface and prewired primitive picks the theme up automatically

items.question: How do I customize the agent's system prompt?
keyPoints: The system prompt assembles four channels
Channels are product brief, company directions, host instructions, and design rules
Each channel has one contracted place to live

items.question: How does Vendo turn my existing API into agent tools?
keyPoints: Sync extracts OpenAPI, tRPC, server actions, and host routes
Extraction writes .vendo/tools.json
Extracted tools are guarded

items.question: How does Vendo resolve a model in development when I have not set an API key?
keyPoints: createVendo's model option is optional
When omitted, the runtime resolves through the devModel() ladder
Production should set an explicit provider API key

items.question: How do away automations authenticate to my API without a browser session?
items.memoryQuery: seam because none of them carry a browser session
keyPoints: Away runs and MCP calls reach host APIs through the actAs seam
Presets in @vendoai/actions/presets mint the right auth material
Presets cover Auth.js, Supabase, Clerk, and Auth0

items.question: What identity seams does createVendo need from my auth system?
keyPoints: One auth key fills all three identity seams
The seams are the request-to-principal resolver, the actAs seam, and the MCP door's auth

items.question: How does Vendo know which user a request belongs to?
keyPoints: Every wire request resolves a Principal through the principal(req) seam
The returned subject scopes threads, apps, approvals, grants, and runs

items.question: What does Vendo persist and in which database?
items.memoryQuery: embedded pglite database with the same schema
keyPoints: One Postgres-compatible store holds threads, apps, grants, approvals, audit, and more
Local dev uses an embedded PGlite database
PGlite and Postgres share the same schema

items.question: What can trigger an automation?
items.memoryQuery: on a schedule, in response to a host event
keyPoints: Automations fire on a schedule, on a host event, or from a verified external webhook
Long-lived hosts call automations.start(); serverless hosts schedule the tick

items.question: What telemetry does Vendo collect?
keyPoints: Two separate streams: build/development telemetry and capability misses
Build telemetry never fires from a deployed production app
No end-user product data is collected

items.question: My Vendo install seems broken — how do I debug it?
items.memoryQuery: doctor checks local wiring and makes one live
keyPoints: Doctor checks local wiring and makes one live /status round trip
Exit code 0 means the install is healthy
The verify page explains every doctor error code

items.question: What does Vendo Cloud actually host for me?
keyPoints: Cloud hosts sharing of frozen app copies, publishing, sandboxes, store, and org keys
Every cloud capability keeps a bring-your-own path

items.question: Does Vendo run on edge runtimes like Cloudflare Workers?
keyPoints: The server targets Web-standard JavaScript, not Node
A CI gate bundles the server entry for a Worker target and boots it under workerd

items.question: What must be true before I ship Vendo to production?
items.memoryQuery: once these eight things are true
keyPoints: Eight checklist items, worked through in order
Includes resolving every request to a stable Principal subject
Each item links to the page covering it in depth

items.question: How do I add Vendo to my existing Vercel AI SDK chatbot?
items.memoryQuery: keep your vercel ai sdk chatbot as it is
keyPoints: Keep the existing chatbot; three steps add Vendo
Init scaffolds the wire route and turns host actions into agent tools
The agent builds micro-apps in the chat and runs host actions guarded

items.question: How do I add Vendo to a Mastra agent?
items.memoryQuery: keep your mastra agent as it is
keyPoints: Keep the Mastra agent; three steps add Vendo
The agent builds micro-apps in the chat and runs host actions guarded

items.question: I already have an agent loop and chat UI — does Vendo replace them?
items.memoryQuery: one tool pack, spread into your agent's
keyPoints: Vendo replaces nothing: keep the loop, model, and chat UI
One tool pack spread into the agent's tools adds guarded host actions, micro-apps, and approvals

items.question: How do Vendo results reach my own chat UI?
keyPoints: vendo_* tools return one small envelope format
The host loop never needs to know what an app or approval is

items.question: Where is the full configuration reference for bring-your-own-agent setups?
items.memoryQuery: needed for a first successful run; come back when you customize
keyPoints: The configuration page holds everything the quickstarts keep short
Nothing on it is needed for a first successful run

items.question: Which files make up Vendo's server wiring in my repo?
items.memoryQuery: entire server wiring is two files
keyPoints: The entire server wiring is two files, both scaffolded by vendo init
The same registry object serves both sides

items.question: What is the playbook for a coding agent installing Vendo?
items.memoryQuery: installs as one npm package plus a small
keyPoints: Vendo installs as one npm package plus a small .vendo/ contract
Customers build views, act through the host's API as themselves, and automate work

items.question: Can I change the keyboard shortcut that opens the palette?
keyPoints: VendoPalette accepts an optional hotkey prop
Passing false disables the built-in opener entirely

items.question: What UI surfaces does Vendo ship?
keyPoints: The UI package ships the overlay plus optional chrome
Headless hooks power bespoke surfaces

items.question: What limits apply to tool calls made while the user is away?
keyPoints: Away runs execute under scoped grants
Risk and policy still decide run, ask, or block

items.question: At what point in my build does tool extraction actually run?
items.memoryQuery: extraction runs during build and development
keyPoints: Extraction runs during build and development
Sync regenerates .vendo/tools.json

items.question: How does Vendo make sure an incoming webhook is genuine?
keyPoints: External webhooks must be verified before they fire automations
Webhooks are one of three trigger kinds

items.question: What exactly changes when I approve a specific version of a generated app?
items.memoryQuery: that version can also render in the host page
keyPoints: The approved version can render in the host page instead of the iframe
It then shares the page's authority and network

items.question: How do outside agents authenticate when they connect to my MCP door?
keyPoints: Outside agents connect to the MCP door over OAuth
Door tool calls run through the same guard as everything else

items.question: How does Vendo handle users who are not signed in?
keyPoints: Anonymous sessions resolve to a principal like signed-in users
The vendo: namespace marks Vendo-internal actors

items.question: How is edge-runtime compatibility enforced so it cannot silently regress?
keyPoints: A CI gate bundles the server entry for a Worker target
The bundle is booted under workerd on every run

items.question: What happens when the agent is asked for something no tool can do?
keyPoints: Capability misses are recorded as their own stream
Misses signal which tools the host is missing

items.question: What is a block?
keyPoints: A block is one of the ten @vendoai/* packages behind the umbrella
Each block has one job and a well-defined seam

items.question: Define the wire format.
items.memoryQuery: compact jsx-like markup an agent emits
keyPoints: The wire is the compact JSX-like markup an agent emits for a generated app
The runtime validates and renders it in the sandboxed surface

items.question: What is the guard?
items.memoryQuery: policy layer every tool call passes through
keyPoints: The guard is the policy layer every tool call passes through
It grades calls by risk and decides run, ask, or block

items.question: Define principal.
items.memoryQuery: identity a vendo request acts as
keyPoints: A principal is the identity a Vendo request acts as
Tenancy and permissions derive from it server-side

items.question: What is an adapter in Vendo?
items.memoryQuery: single seam interface each block exposes
keyPoints: An adapter is the single seam interface a block exposes for a swappable capability
An explicitly passed adapter always wins over key-derived defaults

items.question: What are the knowledge search intents?
keyPoints: Chat is fast retrieval, deep is agentic search, schema is exact lookup
Schema lookups return an honest not-found, never a fuzzy fallback

items.question: What is a posture?
keyPoints: A posture is an adapter's declared capability surface
Conformance tests verify the declaration instead of trusting it

items.question: What is a venue?
keyPoints: A venue is where an agent surface runs: in-client, hosted, or automation
Policy and approvals are venue-aware

items.question: What is a citation?
keyPoints: A citation is a doc-id plus engine-scoped chunk-id reference
Citations render as chips and resolve through the adapter's fetch

items.question: What commands does the vendo CLI have?
keyPoints: The umbrella owns the vendo bin
Nine commands: init, login, doctor, sync, eject, extract, playground, mcp, cloud

items.question: Which environment variables configure the Vendo host?
keyPoints: VENDO_TICK_SECRET, VENDO_BASE_URL, VENDO_POSTHOG_KEY, and VENDO_BOX_* are implementation-level config
The frozen contracts define the corresponding bearer, route origin, and telemetry behavior

items.question: Which createVendo options are required?
keyPoints: Every key is optional; oauth becomes required when mcp is enabled
A bare createVendo() boots with an env-resolved model

items.question: Which .vendo files are machine-written and which are hand-edited?
keyPoints: tools.json is the machine layer vendo sync regenerates wholesale
overrides.json is the only hand-edited file
Extraction can never overwrite reviewed risk answers

items.question: What headless hooks does the UI package expose?
keyPoints: @vendoai/ui exposes headless React hooks reading the same wire as the built-in chrome
Pair them with your own UI for a bespoke surface

items.question: What HTTP routes does the Vendo handler serve?
items.memoryQuery: http routes: threads, approvals, mcp door
keyPoints: Routes cover threads, approvals, the MCP door, and OAuth
All routes mount under the single wire handler

items.question: Where is the server API for the composition documented?
keyPoints: The server API reference covers the @vendoai/vendo composition
createVendo is the composition entry point
